objective: The three lions (Lion, Sun Lion and a new legendary Shadow Lion, twist speed) rebuilt from scratch as faceted low-poly cats after the Sun Lion reference card from SHANNON (decision 0050), with a presentation render of each. Concept only: nothing is uploaded or wired into the game until SHANNON approves.
acceptance_criteria: The three lions read as one family in the style of the reference: faceted bodies, a mane of crystal shards, paws with toes, slit eyes
Each builds, bakes and exports through the normal build with the usual rig pieces and joints
The other animals build as before
StationConfig, StationAssets and the manifest are untouched until SHANNON approves and the models are uploaded
verification: Blender 5.2 on 2026-11-15, after the pass to match the reference card (a fuller mane, a chunkier body and legs, the sun with rays, a bigger tail flame, the face): full build (bake and export) of creature_lion (1584 tris, 7.5 tall x 13.0 long), creature_lion_sun (1808, 9.2 x 16.1) and creature_lion_shadow (1656, 8.5 x 15.0), with the mane swept back passed, with body, head, four legs and tail pieces and the glow pieces; the hero render was compared side by side with the reference. The manifest was restored after the test builds, so the game is unchanged. Lune 687/687. Not done: the upload, the StationConfig variant, the new shapes under the walk and attack clips in the game.
notes: Checkpoint for SHANNON: approve the faceted lions and the Shadow Lion, then the next step is the build for upload, the Upload Blender assets workflow and the StationConfig variant. Open: whether the other animals follow the style; an aura effect in the game for the Sun Lion; a look at the clips on the new legs. Generator trial on 2026-11-15 (SHANNON asked): Studio's mesh generator from a text description gave a plain low-poly lion (lumpy mane with holes where the head was cut from the body, a thin tail with no flame, no glowing eyes) and published asset 83393387271349 to SHANNON's account; the block generator fed the reference image gave a crude block lion with a flat yellow starburst for a mane. Neither is nearer the reference than the Blender lions. The generated asset is not used in the game and not in the asset register; both trial models sit only in the local Studio session (Workspace.LionTrial).
evidence: Merged in PR #25 as commit 8dd70e2 (2026-11-19); CI verify passed: https://github.com/TheAnnoyingPikachu/roblox-ai-dev/actions/runs/44431966662
Accepted by SHANNON in bulk (decision 0123, Round 2 build 10 A, 2026-11-27); verification as recorded above
